title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Pre-Work Deposit: Terms and Customer Payment Tool
content:
**Rule.** A Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket in a service class whose deposit percentage is above 0 owes a deposit before the tailor starts the work. The deposit is taken after drop-off and before the tailor starts the work.

**When the deposit is worked out.**
- The deposit on a ticket accepted with rush service is worked out only after that ticket carries its rush fee.
- A deposit is not taken until any Finch Circle rush fee waiver the ticket is owed stands on it.

So on a rush ticket whose charges do not yet include its rush fee, the deposit is not yet worked out; and while a Finch Circle rush fee waiver the ticket is owed does not yet stand on it, the deposit is not yet taken.

**Tenders.** This deposit is paid with any tender the class accepts other than Finch Circle alteration credit. The balance due is still paid at pickup, with any accepted tender.

## The customer's payment tool

The deposit is paid by the customer themselves with `pay_ticket_deposit_a1dd4c80`. Customer care unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer runs it.

**What it does.** One call adds a single deposit payment, dated today, to the ticket and lowers the ticket's balance due by the amount paid; the customer then sees the deposit among the ticket's payments and a lower balance due.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | the reference number of the customer's alteration ticket, as customer care reads it out from the ticket lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the deposit paid, as customer care states it | USD, positive, 2 decimal places (dollars and cents); stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places |
| `tender_type` | how the customer pays, as the customer chooses | one of `mf_card` (charged to the customer's Marlowe & Finch store card or Marlowe & Finch Mastercard), `bank_card` (charged to another bank's credit card), `debit` (paid with a debit card), `cash` (paid in cash at the store counter), `gift_card` (paid from a Marlowe & Finch gift card) |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new payment reference number (an opaque string starting with "adp_"), the ticket reference number, the deposit paid in USD with 2 decimal places, the tender used, and the ticket's new balance due in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the deposit is paid and recorded on the ticket.

## Basis Q&A

**Can Finch Circle alteration credit pay this deposit?** No; the tool's tenders are a Marlowe & Finch card, another bank's credit card, debit, cash and a Marlowe & Finch gift card.

**Does a class with a deposit percentage of 0 owe this deposit?** No.
